item.tib: kun tu bzang po nam mkha'i rgyal po'i yi ge 'khor lo ye shes snying po'i rgyud
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan bde chen gling pa can gyis yongs rdzogs dpal gyi phug nas sa pho rta lor spyan drangs ste (te)/ slar lcags bya lor stag rtse rin chen 'bar ba nas legs par phab cing drung yig pa ni mu wer mang gas bgyis par dge'o/ bon 'di nyi zer sa yi rdul bzhin rgyas par shog/
